PLAN "Return to Strength: 3-Week Reconditioning"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore baseline strength after deconditioning"

PHASES
  PHASE "Week 1: Movement Restoration" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body Foundation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x5 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          lat_stretch 90s
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Body Foundation":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90s
          hamstring_stretch 90s
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Light":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x6 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          squat 2x6 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 2x6 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m

  PHASE "Week 2: Volume Build" (1 week):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Power":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          shoulder_stretch 90s
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Power":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90s
          hip_flexor_stretch 90s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Moderate":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 4m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m

  PHASE "Week 3: Strength Return" (1 week):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4 rpe 7 rest 100 seconds
          barbell_row 5x4 rpe 7 rest 100 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          back_stretch 90s
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x4 rpe 7 rest 100 seconds
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90s
          hamstring_stretch 90s
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
